question.worked_solution:
Notice that the terms of the corresponding sequence

$$
4, \quad 8, \quad 12, \quad , \ldots, \quad 56, \quad 60.
$$

 are multiples of $4,$ and since $60\div 4 = 15,$ there are $15$ terms in total. 

Therefore, the $n$th term of the sequence has the form

$$
a_n =4n,
$$

where $n$ ranges from $n=1$ to $n=15\mathbin{.}$ Indeed:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{1} & =4(1)=4 \\ {a}_{2} & =4(2)=8 \\ {a}_{3} & =4(3)=12 \\  & \,\,⋮ \\ {a}_{14} & =4(14)=56 \\ {a}_{15} & =4(15)=60\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\eqalign{
S=4+8+12+\cdots+56+60=\sum_{n=1}^{15} 4n.
}
$$
